name: World-Space Voxel Resolution for Remeshing
aliases: Honor world-space voxel resolution independently of the active object's transform
definition: A technique to ensure voxel resolution is defined in world units rather than the mesh's local coordinate frame, preventing resolution artifacts caused by object scale transforms.
summary: World-Space Voxel Resolution for Remeshing defines voxel size in world units rather than local coordinates, ensuring consistent geometric fidelity regardless of object scale or transform.
